kill_rules: At about $5 spend with weak search terms, irrelevant intent, or no qualified product engagement: pause, narrow, or add negatives after approval.
At $9.49-$10.77 spend with 0 purchases: force pause, narrowing pass, or owner decision.
At $16 spend with 0 purchases: hard pause the unit.
After 2 purchases, hold or reduce if CPA is above $10.77 or ROAS is below 650%.
Do not scale from CTR, add-to-cart, checkout starts, saves, outbound clicks, or cheap CPC alone.
scale_rules: Require at least 3 purchases in the unit being scaled.
Require trusted primary purchase value, correct currency, and clean transaction IDs.
Require CPA at or below $10.77 or ROAS at or above 650%.
Prefer CPA below $8.75 or ROAS at or above 800% before larger scaling.
Use 10%-20% increases for borderline winners and 20%-30% for clean winners, no more often than every 3-7 days.

pinterest: Warm retargeting without urgency, discount, or availability claims

evidence_needed_for_stronger_claims.fast_shipping: Market-specific checkout delivery estimates, shipping-policy source text, provider proof, and recent order delivery evidence.
evidence_needed_for_stronger_claims.free_shipping: Country-specific checkout rate readback and current policy/source confirmation; outbound shipping must not be called returns.
evidence_needed_for_stronger_claims.discount_or_promo: Live storefront promo evidence, approved terms, start/end dates, coupon rules, and destination-page consistency.
evidence_needed_for_stronger_claims.reviews_or_ratings: Live review system evidence, count/rating source, product or brand scope, and screenshot/API readback.
evidence_needed_for_stronger_claims.bestseller_or_popular: Recent sales/order evidence by SKU/category, date range, and comparison-set definition.
evidence_needed_for_stronger_claims.price_claims: Live PDP price and target-country currency readback, including variant-level price if relevant.
evidence_needed_for_stronger_claims.availability: Feed/PDP eligibility proof only; do not convert channel salability into warehouse, stocked, local inventory, or guaranteed-on-hand claims.
evidence_needed_for_stronger_claims.local_language_quality: Native or high-confidence QA of landing page, policy, cart, checkout, sizing, and support wording.
